tweets.text:
Guess what?

Its ok to be an...

-"average"
-have-a-life-outside-of-work
-non-superhero
-boundary-having
-career progressing
-community participating

...product manager.

stop buying into the product manager hustle porn

its OK to be "just" good

the nature of the role is such that you can rationalize trying ...

to be more and more things to more and more ppl.

To have influence on more and more things.

To optimize your time more and more.

To play 3dl chess...more and more

to fix more problems in your org

NO NO NO

I'd even venture to say that the heroic PM archetype is holding companies back

it creates learned helplessness on the part of other people

information silos

PMs hoarding information

fragility

normalizes org dysfunction
